findings.location: Psalm 40:5, in the opening quotation and the later italicized quotation
findings.source_quote: “they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee”
findings.suggested_fix: In both locations, replace “nichts ist dir gleich” with wording that conveys that God’s works and thoughts cannot be counted or set out before him, for example: “sie lassen sich vor dir nicht der Reihe nach aufzählen.”

findings.source_quote: “Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “verstummen” with wording conveying that they are left desolate or appalled as a consequence of their shame, for example: “Lass sie als Lohn für ihre Schande verstört zurückbleiben.”

findings.source_quote: “Many, O Lord, are Thy wonderful works”
findings.suggested_fix: Add “Viele” at the beginning of the quoted sentence, for example: “Viele sind, HERR, deine Wunder …”
